gapReason.reason: The row is the deck's RAILS CONFIG - the thirty files under card-1.110.0/config/ (the environments, the core extensions, the initializers, the locales) and the four schema files under db/. The port is not Rails: it has no Rails initializers, no Rails environment files and no Rails schema loader, because its schema is the port's own (db/schema.sqlite.sql) and its configuration is the deck manifest plus the host's environment variables. So the twenty-nine defs the port does not carry are the Rails core extensions (the Hash and Module extensions at config/initializers/01_core_extensions/, the ActiveRecord patches at config/initializers/02_patches/, the better_errors patch) - mechanisms Rails provides and the port has no use for.
